meta.title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
meta.source_note: Base Rules 1-34 from the official Department of Consumer Affairs PDF; later amendment links are maintained on the official index.

rules.title: Short title and commencement
rules.requirement: Identifies these as the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, effective 1 April 2011.
rules.description: Preliminary provision establishing title and commencement.
rules.applicability: Informational; applies to the rule set.
rules.violation_condition: Not a package-label check.
rules.consumer_explanation: This provision identifies the governing rules.
rules.inspector_explanation: Informational provision; no image-based violation is generated.

rules.title: Definitions
rules.requirement: Defines dealer, manufacturer, packer, net quantity, principal display panel, retail package, retail sale price, wholesale package and related terms.
rules.description: Interpretation provision for the rule set.
rules.violation_condition: Not independently violated by label text.
rules.consumer_explanation: This rule explains the legal meaning of key label terms.
rules.inspector_explanation: Use the definitions when classifying package and declaration evidence.

rules.title: Applicability of the Chapter
rules.requirement: Retail package requirements do not apply above 25 kg/25 L except specified cement/fertilizer bags, or to institutional/industrial consumers.
rules.violation_condition: Not a violation; out-of-scope packages are marked not applicable.
rules.consumer_explanation: Some bulk or institutional packages follow different requirements.
rules.inspector_explanation: Confirm quantity and buyer type before applying retail rules.

rules.title: Regulation for pre-packing and sale of commodities
rules.requirement: A commodity may not be pre-packed for sale, distribution or delivery unless its package bears the declarations required by these Rules.
rules.description: General obligation to label pre-packaged commodities.
rules.violation_condition: One or more required declarations are confirmed absent or invalid.
rules.consumer_explanation: The package should carry all legally required information.
rules.inspector_explanation: Evaluate the complete declaration set across every uploaded face.

rules.title: Recommended standard packages
rules.requirement: Second Schedule commodities should use specified quantities; other sizes require a prominent non-standard pack-size declaration.
rules.violation_condition: A scheduled commodity uses a non-standard size without the prescribed declaration.
rules.consumer_explanation: Certain products should use standard pack sizes or clearly say they do not.
rules.inspector_explanation: Confirm commodity mapping and quantity against the Second Schedule.

rules.title: Declarations to be made on every package
rules.requirement: Every package must conspicuously declare manufacturer/packer/importer details, commodity name, net quantity, month/year, retail sale price, dimensions where relevant, and prescribed additional matters.
rules.applicability: All in-scope packages, subject to stated category exemptions.
rules.required_declaration: Manufacturer, commodity, net quantity, date, MRP, dimensions where relevant
rules.violation_condition: A declaration is confirmed missing or fails its prescribed form.
rules.consumer_explanation: Key product, quantity, price, date and business details must be clear on the package.
rules.inspector_explanation: Search all uploaded faces and apply category-specific provisos before deciding.

rules.title: Principal display panel area and type size
rules.requirement: Numerals must meet Table I/II minimum heights; letters must be at least 1 mm, or 2 mm when blown, formed, moulded, embossed or perforated.
rules.applicability: Declarations on the principal display panel.
rules.violation_condition: Measured lettering or numerals are below the applicable threshold.
rules.consumer_explanation: Important price and quantity text must be large enough to read.
rules.inspector_explanation: Physical millimetre measurements require calibration; otherwise manual verification is required.

rules.title: Declaration where to appear
rules.requirement: Declarations must appear on the principal display panel, with prescribed clear space around the quantity declaration.
rules.violation_condition: A declaration is outside the PDP or quantity clear space is insufficient.
rules.consumer_explanation: Required information should be easy to find on the main display area.
rules.inspector_explanation: Use calibrated geometry where available; otherwise mark for manual verification.

rules.title: Manner in which declaration shall be made
rules.requirement: Declarations must be legible and prominent; price and quantity numerals must contrast with the background; outside wrappers must repeat or reveal declarations; text must be Hindi or English (additional languages permitted).
rules.description: Legibility, contrast, wrapper and language provision.
rules.violation_condition: Confirmed illegibility, inadequate contrast, hidden declarations or unsupported language substitution.
rules.consumer_explanation: Mandatory information should be readable and in Hindi or English.
rules.inspector_explanation: Image-quality uncertainty is not a confirmed violation; request manual verification when needed.

rules.title: Name and address of manufacturer etc.
rules.requirement: The package must conspicuously state the actual name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer where different, or importer for imported goods.
rules.description: Complete business identity and address requirement.
rules.applicability: All in-scope packages, with limited tiny-package provision.
rules.violation_condition: Business name/address is confirmed absent or materially incomplete.
rules.consumer_explanation: You should be able to identify and contact the business responsible for the product.
rules.inspector_explanation: Verify role wording, postal address and PIN code across all faces.

rules.title: General provisions relating to quantity
rules.requirement: Declared net quantity excludes wrappers and must account for environmental variation; qualifying words such as 'when packed' apply only as prescribed.
rules.applicability: Packages sold by weight, measure or number.
rules.violation_condition: The declaration includes packaging or uses an impermissible qualification.
rules.consumer_explanation: The quantity should describe the product, not the wrapper.
rules.inspector_explanation: Physical short-quantity testing remains a manual inspection step.

rules.title: Manner of declaration of quantity
rules.requirement: Quantity must use weight, measure, number or a suitable combination, give accurate information, and avoid misleading qualifiers such as minimum, average or about.
rules.description: Format and wording of quantity declaration.
rules.violation_condition: Quantity format is invalid or uses misleading qualifiers.
rules.consumer_explanation: The amount in the package should be stated clearly without vague wording.
rules.inspector_explanation: Validate raw OCR text, unit and surrounding qualifiers.

rules.title: Statement of units of weight, measure or number
rules.requirement: Quantities must use the prescribed SI unit and scale; items sold by number use N or U; dozen, score and gross are not permitted.
rules.violation_condition: A non-standard unit or prohibited counting term is used.
rules.consumer_explanation: Quantity should use familiar standard units such as g, kg, ml or L.
rules.inspector_explanation: Normalize punctuation/case but preserve the printed raw value as evidence.

rules.title: Dimensions of certain commodities
rules.requirement: Bed-sheets, sarees, towels and similar goods must state number and finished dimensions; differing pieces require individual dimensions and prices.
rules.violation_condition: Required dimensions are confirmed absent for an applicable commodity.
rules.consumer_explanation: Size information should be stated for products such as sheets and towels.
rules.inspector_explanation: Apply only after category classification confirms relevance.

rules.title: Dimensions and weight in certain cases
rules.requirement: Where price relates to both dimensions and weight, the quantity declaration must include both.
rules.applicability: Commodities priced by related dimensions and weight.
rules.violation_condition: An applicable product lacks either dimension or weight.
rules.consumer_explanation: Products priced by size and weight should show both.
rules.inspector_explanation: Requires product-type and pricing-basis confirmation.

rules.title: Number of usable sheets
rules.requirement: Aluminium foil, facial tissues, toilet paper and similar packages must state usable sheet count and dimensions of each sheet.
rules.violation_condition: Applicable sheet count/dimensions are confirmed absent.
rules.consumer_explanation: Sheet products should tell you how many usable sheets and their size.
rules.inspector_explanation: Apply only to identified sheet-based categories.

rules.title: Dimensions of container-type commodities
rules.requirement: Bags, boxes, cups and similar containers must declare count and the prescribed linear dimensions/diameter/depth.
rules.applicability: Empty container-type commodities sold as products.
rules.violation_condition: Applicable count/dimensions are confirmed absent.
rules.consumer_explanation: Container products should clearly state count and size.
rules.inspector_explanation: Do not apply to packaging that merely contains another commodity.

rules.title: Wholesale and retail dealer provisions
rules.requirement: Dealers may not sell non-compliant packages, exceed or alter retail sale price, and must follow revised-price provisions.
rules.violation_condition: Dealer conduct or price alteration is established.
rules.consumer_explanation: A retailer should not charge more than the printed MRP.
rules.inspector_explanation: Package OCR alone cannot establish transaction price or dealer conduct.

rules.title: Inspection at manufacturer or packer premises
rules.requirement: Authorized officers may sample and test packages using the Fifth and Sixth Schedules and record results in the Seventh Schedule.
rules.violation_condition: Determined through statutory sampling, not label OCR.
rules.consumer_explanation: Officials use a prescribed physical testing procedure.
rules.inspector_explanation: Use statutory sample sizes and data sheets for quantity enforcement.

rules.title: Action after manufacturer/packer inspection
rules.requirement: Where tested quantity is deficient beyond permissible error or declarations are missing, officers seize samples and initiate action, subject to fresh-test provisions.
rules.violation_condition: Triggered by statutory test report.
rules.consumer_explanation: Confirmed serious failures can lead to seizure and enforcement.
rules.inspector_explanation: The app may support evidence but does not replace statutory procedure.

rules.title: Inspection at wholesale or retail dealer premises
rules.requirement: Dealer-premises quantity tests are conducted for complaints, suspected tampering/leakage, or missing declarations; excess deficiency may lead to seizure.
rules.violation_condition: Established by statutory testing or source investigation.
rules.consumer_explanation: Officials may test suspicious or complained-about packages.
rules.inspector_explanation: Record complaint/tampering basis and physical test result separately.

rules.title: Maximum permissible error
rules.requirement: Quantity error is assessed against the First Schedule while considering packaging, environmental and distribution variation.
rules.violation_condition: Measured deficiency exceeds the applicable maximum permissible error.
rules.consumer_explanation: Small legal tolerances apply, but significant short quantity is not allowed.
rules.inspector_explanation: Requires verified weighing/measuring equipment and First Schedule lookup.

rules.title: Deceptive packages
rules.requirement: A package deliberately creating an exaggerated or misleading impression must be repacked/relabelled or may be seized.
rules.violation_condition: Package design is established as deliberately misleading without justification.
rules.consumer_explanation: Packaging should not make the contents look larger than they are.
rules.inspector_explanation: Requires contextual physical assessment; image screening can only flag for review.

rules.title: Declarations on wholesale packages
rules.requirement: Wholesale packages must state manufacturer/importer/packer, commodity identity, and retail-package count or net quantity.
rules.violation_condition: A required wholesale declaration is confirmed absent.
rules.consumer_explanation: Wholesale packages follow a separate declaration set.
rules.inspector_explanation: Apply only after package type is confirmed wholesale.

rules.title: Export packages sold in India
rules.requirement: Export packages may not be sold in India unless repacked or relabelled to comply with Chapter II.
rules.description: Domestic sale restriction for export packages.
rules.violation_condition: An export package is offered domestically without compliant relabelling.
rules.consumer_explanation: Export-only packs sold in India must still carry Indian retail declarations.
rules.inspector_explanation: Confirm domestic sale context and export marking.

rules.title: Exemption for certain packages
rules.requirement: Specified tiny packages, restaurant/hotel fast food, covered drug formulations and agricultural produce above 50 kg are exempt, subject to stated provisos.
rules.violation_condition: Not a violation; applicable rules become not applicable.
rules.consumer_explanation: Some specialised packages are exempt from some or all requirements.
rules.inspector_explanation: Apply exemptions before declaration validation.

rules.title: Registration of manufacturers, packers and importers
rules.requirement: Persons pre-packing or importing commodities must apply for registration with prescribed particulars and fees.
rules.violation_condition: Required registration is absent or particulars are not maintained.
rules.consumer_explanation: Responsible businesses must be registered with Legal Metrology authorities.
rules.inspector_explanation: Verify against the competent authority's registry; label OCR is insufficient.

rules.title: Registration of shorter address
rules.requirement: A shorter address may be used only when separately registered and sufficient to identify the manufacturer or packer.
rules.applicability: Packages using an approved shorter address.
rules.violation_condition: A shorter address is used without registration or cannot identify the business.
rules.consumer_explanation: A shortened address must still identify the responsible business.
rules.inspector_explanation: Confirm approval in the registration record before treating a short address as compliant.

rules.title: Register of manufacturers and packers
rules.requirement: Director/Controller maintains a publicly inspectable register of registered manufacturers and packers.
rules.violation_condition: Not determined from a package image.
rules.consumer_explanation: Registration records should be available for public inspection.
rules.inspector_explanation: Administrative provision; no scan verdict.

rules.title: Compilation and circulation of manufacturer/packer lists
rules.requirement: Authorities compile state-wise lists of registered manufacturers/packers and circulate them for sampling.
rules.violation_condition: Not determined from a package image.
rules.consumer_explanation: Authorities maintain lists used for inspection planning.
rules.inspector_explanation: Administrative provision; no scan verdict.

rules.title: Price advertisements
rules.requirement: Advertisements mentioning retail sale price must also declare net quantity/number in the same font size as the price.
rules.violation_condition: An advertisement mentions price without equally prominent quantity.
rules.consumer_explanation: Price advertisements should also tell you the package quantity.
rules.inspector_explanation: Package images alone are not advertisement evidence.

rules.title: Penalty for contravention
rules.requirement: Prescribes fines for contraventions where applicable.
rules.violation_condition: Depends on an established underlying contravention.
rules.consumer_explanation: Penalties may apply when the rules are broken.
rules.inspector_explanation: Do not infer penalty solely from automated scan output.

rules.title: Power to relax
rules.requirement: Central Government may permit time-bound relaxation with corrective measures in eligible cases.
rules.applicability: Packages covered by a valid relaxation order.
rules.violation_condition: Automated evaluation cannot determine a valid relaxation order.
rules.consumer_explanation: A formal government relaxation may apply in limited cases.
rules.inspector_explanation: Verify documentary authority before overriding rule results.

rules.title: Repeal and savings
rules.requirement: Repeals the 1977 Rules while preserving prior rights, liabilities, proceedings, registrations and actions.
rules.violation_condition: Not a package-label check.
rules.consumer_explanation: Earlier legal actions and registrations remain protected.
rules.inspector_explanation: Informational transition provision; no scan verdict.
